title.value: Ti saluto / Faresti meglio a mollare se suoni così!

overview.value: Lilisa had to adapt to her new life of privilege and pretended to be someone she wasn't at Oushin Girls Academy. That is, until she catches Otoha drumming in the music room.

title.value: Unisciti a me! / Non lo posso accettare!

overview.value: Lilisa wants absolutely nothing to do with Otoha anymore. Unfortunately for her, that's easier said than done since the drummer refuses to leave her alone.

title.value: Facciamolo! Sai che sarà bellissimo! / Formiamo una band?

overview.value: Lilisa's love of rock roars back to life during a jam session. She may pretend otherwise, but once unleashed, her repressed spirit will not back down without a fight.

title.value: Cerchiamo altri membri? / Le farò cacciare di casa!

overview.value: Alice despises her new sister and mother and is determined to drive them out of her home. Meanwhile, Lilisa and Otoha start their search for new band members.

title.value: È emozionante, vero? / Io l'ho sbattuto sul tavolo, vedi di farlo anche tu!

overview.value: Lilisa and Otoha vow to wipe that cocky grin straight off Jun's stupid face with a performance to remember! Little do they know, however, that Alice is in the audience.

title.value: Mi lasceresti unire alla band? / Abbandonala seduta stante!

overview.value: The Prince of Oushin is renowned by the entire school, but she's hiding a secret, just like Lilisa. Meanwhile, Otoha receives an unexpected offer from an old friend.

title.value: Voglio cambiare me stessa! / Arriva a questo livello, scarsona.

overview.value: Thanks to Otoha, the four band members will participate in a battle of the bands. Tina shows no signs of improving and talks of kicking her out begin.

title.value: Non è mai tempo perso! / Ho un piano segreto!

overview.value: Five days—if Tina can improve in five days then she can stay in the band. Lilisa will make sure of it.

title.value: Le prossime siamo noi! / Chiudete la bocca, tutti quanti!

overview.value: The battle of the bands kicks off and their problems immediately begin. Tina is out of sync, and Lilisa's performance stands out in a bad way.

title.value: Non sai fare di meglio?! / Voglio suonare il rock con loro!

overview.value: Tempers flare after a crushing defeat, but not for the expected reason. Tamaki finally understands why Otoha chose Lilisa over her and has an important decision to make.

title.value: Voglio diventare una Noble Maiden / Ti fa solamente danzare

overview.value: As Lilisa strives to become a refined lady for her mother's sake, she unexpectedly encounters a former student who has been honored with the title of Noble Maiden.

title.value: Mi trovo costretta a tirarmi indietro / Dimostrerò che siamo le migliori!

overview.value: Lilisa and the others gear up for their final shot to rock the Live House, resolved to take down the boy band Bacchus.
Rebellion is the soul of rock, so who cares what anyone thinks? Rock Lady's passion roars through every beat, and they'll prove it to Bacchus, the crowd, and themselves.
